meta.name: predictable-revenue
meta.description: Build a scalable outbound B2B sales machine with specialized roles (SDR, AE, CSM). Use when the user mentions "outbound sales", "Cold Calling 2.0", "cold email sequences", "sales pipeline", "SDR process", "sales development", "build an outbound sales team", or "fill my pipeline". Also trigger when setting up a B2B SaaS sales team from scratch or building a lead-qualification framework to improve close rates. Covers the three lead types (seeds/nets/spears), role specialization, the referral-email method, ANUM qualification, and pipeline math. For offer design, see hundred-million-offers. For persuasion science, see influence-psychology.

copy.tagline: 搭建可扩展的B2B外呼销售体系
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在从零搭建B2B销售团队或优化外呼流程。
copy.tagline_en: Build a scalable B2B outbound sales machine
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building a B2B sales team from scratch or optimizing outbound processes.

howto.what: Claude 会指导你搭建可预测的B2B外呼销售体系，包括角色分工（SDR、AE、CSM）、冷呼叫2.0流程、ANUM资格认定和管道数学，帮助你从收入目标倒推所需活动量。
howto.when: 当你提到“外呼销售”、“冷呼叫2.0”、“冷邮件序列”、“销售管道”、“SDR流程”等关键词，或需要从零搭建B2B SaaS销售团队、建立线索资格认定框架时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个SDR团队，从零开始搭建外呼销售流程。
say.note: Claude会给出角色分工、招聘建议和冷呼叫2.0步骤。

say.text: 用ANUM框架帮我评估这个线索是否合格。
我的收入目标是500万，平均客单价5万，需要多少SDR？
say.note: Claude会使用管道数学计算所需机会数和SDR人数。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you to build a predictable B2B outbound sales system, including role specialization (SDR, AE, CSM), Cold Calling 2.0 process, ANUM qualification, and pipeline math to work backward from revenue goals.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "outbound sales", "Cold Calling 2.0", "cold email sequences", "sales pipeline", "SDR process", or need to set up a B2B SaaS sales team from scratch or build a lead-qualification framework.

say_en.text: Help me design an SDR team and build an outbound sales process from scratch.
say_en.note: Claude provides role breakdown, hiring tips, and Cold Calling 2.0 steps.

say_en.text: Use the ANUM framework to qualify this lead.
say_en.note: Claude walks through Authority, Need, Urgency, Money.

say_en.text: My revenue target is $5M, average deal size $50K, how many SDRs do I need?
say_en.note: Claude uses pipeline math to calculate opportunities and SDR headcount.
